natural_control_18C.rationale: Natural must baseline to quantify transfer from the current wine matrix.

natural_cold_hot_switch.rationale: Natural matrix with temperature excitation and a modest YAN pulse.

natural_glucose_pulse_after_growth.rationale: Natural must with glucose perturbation to test sugar-transfer validity.

synthetic_natural_like_control.rationale: Synthetic must matched to natural macronutrients; isolates matrix effect.

synthetic_high_sugar_reference.rationale: Synthetic high-sugar operating point close to the current synthetic dataset.

synthetic_glucose_rich_fructose_pulse.rationale: High glucose plus fructose pulse separates glucose and fructose uptake/yield directions.

synthetic_fructose_rich_glucose_pulse.rationale: Fructose-rich run probes iG and fructose kinetic directions.

synthetic_low_yan_ladder.rationale: Low-YAN ladder targets sN and qN separation.

synthetic_low_sugar_saturation_scan.rationale: Low/intermediate sugar levels excite sG and sF instead of keeping saturation flat.

synthetic_ethanol_inhibition_challenge.rationale: Initial ethanol decouples ethanol inhibition from ethanol generated by fermentation.

synthetic_late_ethanol_death_probe.rationale: Late ethanol stress plus Xd observation targets Kd0/iE.

synthetic_high_biomass_low_N_maintenance.rationale: High biomass with low N creates low-growth sugar consumption windows for m0.

synthetic_viable_biomass_step.rationale: Known viable biomass addition tests rate proportionality to X and supports yield separation.

synthetic_pyruvate_peak_lowN_warm_shift.rationale: Low initial YAN plus warm shift targets pyruvate peak and acetaldehyde drainage without adding new states.

synthetic_acetaldehyde_redox_proxy_ethan.rationale: Ethanol stress and temperature perturb acetate/acetaldehyde directions while O2 remains measured, not controlled.

synthetic_fast_CO2_aroma_strip_highN.rationale: High-rate fermentation excites CO2 stripping and liquid/condensate aroma split.

natural_aroma_matrix_cold_hot.rationale: Natural-matrix temperature excitation tests whether aroma/secondary parameters transfer to wine must.

natural_CO2_strip_reference_highN.rationale: Natural high-rate reference for online CO2 and final condensate constraints.

synthetic_lit_SM70_18C_lowN_phase.rationale: Literature SM70-like low YAN level tests nitrogen-limited pyruvate/aldehyde and aroma phase behavior.

synthetic_lit_SM230_18C_midN_reference.rationale: Literature SM230-like mid YAN reference near reported higher-alcohol optimum.

synthetic_lit_SM410_18C_highN_ester.rationale: Literature SM410-like high YAN tests ester capacity and nitrogen-saturated aroma phase.

synthetic_lit_SM410_24C_highN_strip.rationale: High YAN plus warm high-rate fermentation excites CO2 stripping and temperature-partition effects.

synthetic_lit_SM70_warm_shift_Nrescue.rationale: Low initial YAN with operational N rescue tests phase transition timing and practical nutrient intervention.

natural_lit_midN_24C_matrix_transfer.rationale: Natural must at literature-like mid/high YAN and warm phase checks synthetic-to-natural transfer.
